panels.label: 使用展示
panels.copy_purpose: 商品真实使用方式和比例
panels.scene_prompt_en: Show the exact product being used naturally in the most plausible way supported by the reference; if interaction is uncertain, use a non-contact contextual display.
panels.backdrop_en: Minimal premium environment appropriate to the product's observed function.
panels.composition_en: Show the complete product and scale clearly on the right; keep the left side calm.
panels.lighting_en: Natural commercial daylight with accurate materials.

panels.label: 结构展示
panels.copy_purpose: 完整结构、轮廓、部件和比例
panels.scene_prompt_en: Create a precise three-quarter product view documenting the exact silhouette, structure, components, and proportions.
panels.composition_en: Keep the complete product in the upper-middle and reserve the lower area.
panels.lighting_en: Large soft light with clean edge definition.

panels.label: 关键细节
panels.copy_purpose: 完整商品中突出材质、纹理、连接、功能和品牌元素
panels.scene_prompt_en: Show the exact complete product in a detail-led photograph that reveals its distinctive observed material, texture, construction, functional, and brand details through angle and lighting.
panels.backdrop_en: Minimal tonal surface appropriate to the product.
panels.composition_en: Keep the full silhouette and every outer edge inside frame, with details readable on the left and the upper-right reserved.

panels.label: 场景展示
panels.copy_purpose: 符合用途的商业生活场景
panels.scene_prompt_en: Place the exact complete product in a believable premium context supported by its observed use, without invented accessories attached to it.
panels.composition_en: Keep the product lower-right and preserve the upper-left.

panels.label: 商品主视觉
panels.copy_purpose: 完整商品轮廓和设计语言的广告主视觉
panels.scene_prompt_en: Create a premium isolated hero advertisement of the exact complete product at its most informative natural angle.
panels.backdrop_en: Sculptural neutral studio with subtle tonal planes.
panels.composition_en: Place the complete product slightly left and reserve a quiet lower-right.
panels.lighting_en: Controlled campaign light with clean silhouette separation.
